note: Measurement dependencies the WORKBOOK ITSELF states (Phase 2, docs/HEALTH-ASSIST-APPROACH.md §5). Each entry quotes the workbook text it rests on; the suite checks every quote is present in that rule's field. `blocker` is the rule whose failure (or non-assessment) makes `blocks` provisional; `blocks` is a rule (`rule:ID`), a module (`cmdb`) or a module dimension (`cmdb:D7`). Causal links that are NOT measurement dependencies are deliberately left out — e.g. DQ-102 "gates class inconsistency into CMDB-028" describes a cause flowing into CMDB-028, not a precondition for measuring it.
semantics: A target is PROVISIONAL on a run when its blocker failed, or when its blocker could not be assessed (a precondition that was not established is not a precondition that held). The target is still evaluated and shown; its result carries the blocker, and a module-level target marks the module's validity.
